q1_issues.issue: The witness for the subject 'It' is never typed - no (Member sk_it_1 thing) atom is emitted - so the Agent of the only asserted event is an untyped referent, and the symbol is built from the pronoun instead of the required sk_<class>_<n> form.

notes: The reduced relative 'played by Audrey Heppurn' takes the event form with the by-phrase as Agent and the modified noun as Theme, the misspelled surface name is preserved verbatim in the Name string, and VP-focus 'Also' with the verb-class lemma as filler are all as specified. Goal for 'adds to the personality' is defensible since 'to' is a listed oblique role.
